posts.description:
November is here, and so is another edition of What’s Budding? 🌱

From festive Halloween celebrations to meaningful moments of service and connection, EduBud has had another month filled with friendship, creativity, and community!

This edition features our November Volunteer Spotlight, Kevin Lee, and Student Spotlight, Glenn, along with highlights from the ARC x EduBud BBQ Party, Dinner & Boovie at Suwanee Town Center, our Cup of Connection Tea Party, and more!

We’re also excited to share updates on the Dear Buddy Project, our upcoming Christmas Mason Jar Fundraiser, and new opportunities to get involved!

A huge thank-you to all our volunteers, students, families, and chapter leaders for making these moments possible. Your dedication continues to make EduBud a community where everyone belongs. We can’t wait to see what’s budding next!

Swipe through to catch up on everything happening at EduBud!

posts.description:
You’re invited to the Dear Buddy Project 💌🩵 

This November, write a thoughtful letter or handmade card to an EduBud student, teacher, intern, or sponsor! Introduce yourself, share a little about your interests, offer encouragement, or thank someone for the difference they make.

📬 Scan the QR code at your chapter’s drop box to meet our Community Center students and choose your buddy. ✍️ Include your recipient’s name, your name, and your chapter, if applicable. 🗓️ Submit by November 30! 🤍 Earn 0.5 volunteer hours per qualifying letter, up to 3 hours for 6 letters. Letters must be thoughtful, readable, respectful, and complete.
Swipe for instructions and drop-off locations. 

Everyone is welcome to participate, and we can’t wait to see what you write!

posts.description:
A Cup of Connection Tea Party Recap!

What a wonderful time at our very first Community Skills Event! Our EduBud students took on the roles of baristas, servers, and order takers, practicing real-world skills while building confidence, teamwork, and meaningful connections with our senior guests.

A big thank you to Peachtree Christian Health, our students, volunteers, and everyone who helped make this event so special! 

Here’s to more opportunities to learn, connect, and grow together!

#edubud #edubudinternational #community #learningtogether #acupofconnection

October was Down Syndrome Awareness Month, but the friendships, love, and appreciation we have for our students extend far beyond a single month. 🥰🥰

We asked some of our volunteers to share a little of the love, laughter, and friendship they’ve found in getting to know our students with Down Syndrome. 🥹🥹

Our students have just as much to teach us as we hope to teach them. They remind us to be patient, to celebrate the little things, and to recognize the beauty in getting to know someone for exactly who they are.

Let’s continue to challenge our own assumptions, and create spaces where every individual is welcomed, valued, and given the chance to learn and contribute. Inclusion is what we should practice every single day. 💛

#downsyndromeawareness #downsyndrome #fyp #awareness #viral
